name: Private utility locating & concrete GPR scanning — owner-operator for renovation subcontractors and GCs, Chicago + Cook/DuPage
summary: Recurring B2B accounts. A 'customer' is an active contractor account (electrical, plumbing/mechanical, GC, coring) that books scanning/locating visits; ARPC = average monthly billing per active account. Stage E capital-light structure: months 1-3 are a rented-kit pilot (rental expensed; no equipment bought); the founder's own concrete GPR + EM kit is bought in month 4 only after the promotion gate passes; the utility GPR cart is rented per job until month 13 and then leased; technicians are hired only when the founder carries ~20 active accounts (one per +20), with their kit leased (~7% APR, 36 months) and their own car reimbursed at the IRS rate instead of a $45k purchased kit + vehicle; the business-development hire is triggered by 45 active accounts, not by the calendar. Operating profit is before owner compensation and includes the founder's own field work.
evidence_notes: Price evidence: GSA CALC ceiling rates — LaBella 'Subsurface Utility Field Technician' $124.69/h, senior $134.66/h [B, DF-S029] (≈$1,000 per 8-h day); consumer/SEO price guides half-day $300-600, full day $800-1,500 or $1,000-3,000 [D, C3-S028]; GPRS federal awards FY22-26 median $5,800 per project (range $925-$18,609), incl. $5,800 sewer mapping at VA Danville IL [A, DF-S027].

Equipment (dealer list prices, UCG Underground Supplies): Radiodetection RD8200+TX10 $9,592; RD7200+TX5 $5,657; Vivax vLoc3-Pro+Loc3-5Tx $5,530; Radiodetection LMX100 GPR $20,508; LMX200 $36,476; ImpulseRadar PinPointR $18,444; RD8200 kit rental $599/month [B, DF-S026]. Concrete GPR (GSSI Mini XT class) $11-17k [D, C3-S024]; federal buys: ImpulseRadar $16,710 (Army 2024), Leica GPR system $31,417 (NASA 2026) [A, DF-S028].

Demand: City of Chicago issued 5,042 permits with reported cost ≥$250k from Jan 2025 to Nov 2026 (3,325 renovation/alteration) [A, DF-S030]; total issued permits fell 34% 2019-2025 [A, WS10-S010]. JULIE does not locate private lines [B, WS11-S031].

Competition: GPRS (national, Chicago crews, active acquirer) [D, DF-S032, WS13-S033]; Hard Rock Technologies (Chicago, 5 CSDA-certified GPR techs), Butler Scanning (Gurnee), Cobra Concrete Cutting (in-house GPR team) [D, DF-S031].

Labour: BLS/O*NET 2025 Surveying & Mapping Technicians, Chicago median $57,470 [C, DF-S033]; experienced GPR tech assumed $65k + 25% load (E). Productivity ~20 billable visits/tech/month ≈ $180k/yr revenue per tech, vs US NAICS 541370 ~$138k receipts per employee [C, C3-S015].
Pricing and account behaviour (ARPC, churn, win rates) are E — no Chicago rate card or contractor purchase data was found. Validation experiments must establish them.

Stage E corrections (2026-11-28): (1) Stage D bought $42k of equipment in months 1-4 before any proof; Stage E rents in months 1-3 (EM kit $599/$499 per month [B, DF-S026]; concrete GPR $125/day 3-day minimum [B, E-WS13014-S001] or $1,050/week [D, DF-S038]; utility GPR $155/day [B, E-WS13014-S001]) and buys the founder kit only after the gate; the utility GPR cart is leased from month 13. (2) Stage D charged each technician $45k of up-front capex (kit + $20k used vehicle) AND $0.9k/month vehicle cost; Stage E leases the tech kit (published lease schedule implies ~7% APR [B, E-WS13014-S006]) and reimburses mileage at 72.5-76 cents/mile [A, E-WS13014-S016]. (3) Stage D held insurance flat at $750/month regardless of headcount; Stage E adds per-technician workers' comp/auto inside the technician cost. (4) Stage D's BD hire started in month 24 regardless of demand; Stage E triggers it at 45 active accounts. (5) Stage D assumed JULIE tickets on Chicago sites; inside city limits the one-call is 811 Chicago (DIGGER) [A, E-WS13014-S012]. (6) Deliverables must not be labelled ASCE 38 quality levels: a QL requires a PE in responsible charge [C, E-WS13014-S011; A, E-WS13014-S010].

New price anchor: GSA CALC 'Utility Field Technician' $135.26/h (Southeastern Surveying & Mapping) alongside LaBella $124.69/h [B, E-WS13014-S014]. GC insurance requirements (Chicago GC W.E. O'Neil): CGL $1M/$2M with XCU incl. underground, auto $1M, EL $1M, umbrella $2M+, PL $1M if design services [B, E-WS13014-S008]. Insureon excavation-class medians GL $120, E&O $67, umbrella $93, inland marine $101, WC $190, auto $370 per month [D, E-WS13014-S009].

drivers.sales_start_delay_months__source: Month 1: LLC, GL/E&O/umbrella binding, NULCA-accredited EM course ($500, B, E-WS13014-S002), Radiodetection GPR online course ($200, B, E-WS13014-S003), 2 days hands-on concrete GPR training (~$500/day, D, E-WS13014-S004), price-discovery interviews. Rented kit from month 1; first priced jobs month 2-3.
drivers.sales_cycle_months__source: Subs book days ahead; first job usually a trial (Stage C). 811 Chicago/JULIE need 2 business days' notice before digging, so locates are booked 2-14 days ahead [A, E-WS13014-S012].
drivers.founder_leads_per_month__source: Qualified conversations (superintendent/PM meetings, site walks, coring-firm referrals) per month from permit-data targeting [A for target list, DF-S030].
drivers.proposal_to_win_pct__source: First job -> repeat account (GPRS incumbency lowers it).
drivers.rep_new_customers_per_month__source: New accounts per month from a part-time business-development hire (month 24+).
drivers.referral_new_per_100_active__source: Superintendents move between firms; coring/cutting firms refer.
drivers.monthly_churn_pct__source: Accounts lapse between projects; permit volume down 34% 2019-25 [A, WS10-S010].
drivers.arpc_monthly__source: ~1 visit per active account per month x $550-1,000 per visit (half/full-day mix). GSA CALC ceilings $124.69-135.26/h [B, DF-S029; B, E-WS13014-S014]; price guides $300-1,500/visit [D, C3-S028]; GPRS federal project median $5,800 [A, DF-S027]. Conservative $550 = the promotion-gate half-day price with one visit a month.
drivers.gross_margin_pct__source: Direct costs other than technician time: marking paint/flags, mileage beyond base, report printing, consumables (labour is staff).
drivers.cac_per_new_customer__source: Discounted trial scan, lunch-and-learns, travel per won account.
drivers.fixed_marketing_per_month__source: Website/SEO for 'concrete scanning near me', association dues, CRM.
drivers.dso_days__source: Subcontractor/GC net-30 to net-60 (Stage A record); small jobs card-paid on site.
drivers.start_capital_injection__source: Standardization rule: smallest injection that keeps the base-case cash balance >= 0 = base peak funding (incl. $4k/month owner draw from month 13), rounded up to the next $1k. NOT all of it is at risk before proof: see playbook section 8 (capital at risk before the hire gate).
drivers.maint_capex_pct_op__source: Technician kits are leased (replacement sits inside staff cost); owned capex is the founder kit (~$22k) and utility GPR cart (~$20.5k [B, DF-S026]) replaced every ~5-7 years plus calibration -> ~$7-10k/yr = ~4-6% of base op; conservative 10% (lower op, same kit).
drivers.ev_multiple__source: Applied to op before owner pay (SDE-like). GPRS is an active acquirer of small locating/scanning firms (13 deals 2018-25) but discloses no multiples [D, WS13-S033]; a Chicago-suburb owner-operated trade service business asked ~3.2x SDE [D, DF-S004]. Owner-dependent, construction-cyclical book -> 2.0/3.0/3.5x.
drivers.lt_growth_y6_pct__source: Years 6-10 growth = adding 1-2 technician units per year in Cook/DuPage/Lake/Will plus adjacencies (sewer CCTV, mapping); GPRS shows multi-metro scale is possible [D, WS13-S032] but Chicago permit volume fell 34% 2019-25 [A, WS10-S010], so base 8% decaying, conservative 3%.
drivers.lt_growth_decay__source: Metro saturation: one owner-managed firm in a market where GPRS, Hard Rock, Butler and coring firms already operate [D, DF-S031].
drivers.incremental_roic_pct__source: Growth capital per technician unit = lease deposit/tablet ~$3k + receivables (~22 accounts x $750 x 45/30 = ~$25k) + 2-3 months of under-utilisation (~$15-20k) = ~$45k, for ~$40-55k/yr unit operating profit at maturity (model staff/ARPC drivers) -> ~1.0x pre-tax at best; haircut to 0.6 base for slower fill, 0.3 conservative (price pressure from GPRS/coring firms).
drivers.reserve_months__source: Construction-cyclical demand (Chicago permits -34% 2019-25 [A, WS10-S010]) and net-45 receivables justify 2 months of cash costs; 3 in conservative.

staff.role: GPR / locating technician (leased kit, own car reimbursed)
staff.notes: Hired only when the founder carries ~20 active accounts (~23-25 half-day visits/month alongside 10-15 h/week of selling) and then one per +20 accounts (unchanged from Stage D: ~$180k/yr revenue per tech at $750 ARPC, below GPRS-implied ~$200-250k per project manager [E from D, C3-S027]). Monthly cost base = $65k salary x1.25 load incl. payroll tax/WC ($6.8k; Chicago surveying/mapping tech median $57,470, 75th pct $68,640 [C, DF-S033]) + mileage ~900 mi x $0.725-0.76 ($0.7k [A, E-WS13014-S016]) + 36-month lease of a $21.7k concrete GPR + EM kit at ~7% APR ($0.67k [B, E-WS13014-S006]; kit prices B/D, DF-S026, E-WS13014-S004) + tablet/phone/PPE ($0.13k). Conservative: $70k salary, 15% APR, $26.6k kit. Capex/hire = first+last lease payment (~$1.3k), tablet, PPE, marking kit = $3k in all scenarios (the workbook takes one value) (E).
E. Stage E correction: hired when >=45 active accounts prove the account model (Stage D hired at month 24 regardless of demand).
Chicago dispatcher median $58,900 [C, DF-S033]; loaded x1.2 (E).
